verdict.rationale: Browser Use documents a public Cloud API (client.runs.create, sessions, events polling, structured output, CDP connection) across multiple docs pages, indicating a real programmatic interface beyond the UI. However, probes for a formal OpenAPI/swagger spec returned 404s, so there's no machine-readable API contract, only prose docs and SDK examples. Missing for 10: a published OpenAPI/spec artifact, independent third-party confirmation of API usage beyond vendor docs.
